_about.purpose: Hand-made reference labels for the 25 supplied frames, used by eval/evaluate.py.
_about.method: Each frame was inspected at full resolution, and each plate region was cropped and magnified before labelling. Labels are one person's reading of the pixels, not an official record, and they were produced before the pipeline's answers were compared against them.
_about.independence: Where the pipeline's own output is quoted as a hint it is marked in `notes`. No label was taken from a model's guess alone: a character is only recorded when it is legible in the source image.

categories.readable: Every character is legible to a human at full resolution. This is the denominator for exact-match accuracy.
categories.partial: A plate is clearly present and some characters are legible, but at least one is not. Not counted in exact-match; used to measure whether the system correctly abstains.
categories.none_legible: No plate could be read from this frame by the labeller: absent, occluded, turned away, or too small. This is not a claim that the machine has no plate.
